create.name: Nancy Hendrickson
create.bio:
Nancy Hendrickson is a tarot reader, diviner and author whose work centres on connecting with ancestors. Known among readers as the ancestor person, she has worked with tarot and with the beloved dead for decades, and she reads for clients using tarot, oracle cards and charms, with a particular focus on ancestral and seasonal sabbat readings. Her writing blends family history with divination, showing people how to reach towards relatives they may know little about, beyond their grandparents.

Her books form what she calls an ancestral trilogy: Ancestral Tarot, a guide to using the cards to uncover the stories and messages of your family line; Ancestral Grimoire, which turns to the magical practitioners in a person's heritage; and the Ancestral Magick divination kit, with expansion packs, a workbook and a pendulum board. She also created the Ofrenda Oracle. She teaches self-paced courses through the Tarot Readers Academy, including Ancestral Tarot in Practice, on ancestral mediumship with tarot and a pendulum, and The Witch's Workshop, on the fae, land spirits and past lives, and she writes the Hidden Path newsletter on divination and the supernatural. She loves exploring the ancient sites of the American Southwest.

books.title: Ancestral Tarot
books.author: Nancy Hendrickson
books.description: A practical guide to using tarot to learn about and hear from your ancestors, with spreads and exercises that work even when little of the family history is known.

books.title: Ancestral Grimoire
books.author: Nancy Hendrickson
books.description: The second book in her ancestral series, turning to the magical practitioners in one's lineage and how to connect with them through divination and ritual.

courses.title: Ancestral Tarot in Practice
courses.description: A self-paced online course on building your own form of ancestral mediumship, using tarot and a pendulum to contact ancestors and receive their messages, for those who know much or nothing of their family history.

courses.title: The Witch's Workshop: The Fae, Land Spirits, Past Lives
courses.description: A self-paced course on the folklore of the fae, communicating with spirits of the land and exploring past lives, with simple crafts made as magical tools along the way.
